balanced.label: Balanced

info.whenBody: When you need to confirm broader coverage and not just a local match.
info.returnsBody: Results grouped by source type, with a unified score and critical signals visible.
info.decisionBody: Prioritize manual review, open a case or dismiss with greater confidence.

loading.title: Querying extended coverage
loading.description: The platform is comparing the search against internal sources, leaks and external catalogs.

execSummary.title: Executive summary
execSummary.description: A quick read of the search to decide whether it is worth digging in right away.

reading.title: Result interpretation
reading.description: This view synthesizes the detected coverage and highlights the most relevant finding.

federated.noMainFinding: There was no top finding because no source returned matches above the current threshold.

howToRead.title: How to read this query
howToRead.p1: This view does not replace identity verification. It serves to concentrate coverage and indicate where to review first.
howToRead.p2: Prioritize matches with sanctions or a high score. Then review leaks and external context for reputational risk.
howToRead.p3: If there are too many results, raise the threshold. If coverage is lacking, lower the threshold or supplement with the main search.

coverageBySource.title: Coverage by source
coverageBySource.description: Each block explains what type of intelligence was queried and which matches it returned.

noMatches.title: No matches above the threshold
noMatches.description: The query ran correctly, but no source returned sufficient results at the current sensitivity.

summary.none: No matches were detected in the queried sources for this search.
summary.sanctions: Matches with sensitive exposure were detected. Prioritize reviewing sanctions and verify identity before closing the case.
summary.pepAndLeaks: The search combines political exposure and reputational signals. It is advisable to review context, beneficiaries and related links.
summary.pep: Matches with a politically exposed profile were identified. Review the relationship, jurisdiction and how current the context is.
summary.leaks: Exposure was detected in investigative sources. Assess whether the finding changes the reputational risk or the level of due diligence.
summary.generic: There are useful matches for investigation, but no immediate critical signals. Verify identity and coverage before dismissing.

local.label: Internal and regulatory sources
local.description: Regulatory lists, sanctions, PEPs and priority sources already integrated into the platform.
local.summary: Validates immediate exposure within your most critical sources.
local.emptyMessage: No matches in regulatory or internal sources.

leaks.label: Leaks and investigative journalism
leaks.description: Journalistic consortia and databases such as Panama, Paradise and Pandora Papers.
leaks.summary: Useful for detecting reputational exposure or offshore structures.

external.label: Extended external coverage
external.description: External catalogs such as OpenSanctions and Wikidata to broaden the context.
external.summary: Helps validate additional coverage beyond your base sources.
